metadata.how_justification: Reads results.json with json.read_file and compares $.page_count.
metadata.why_justification: Derived figure `page_count`: the size of the audited batch.

metadata.how_justification: Reads results.json with json.read_file and compares $.section_count.
metadata.why_justification: Derived figure `section_count`: the number of sections in the kit.

metadata.how_justification: Reads results.json with json.read_file and compares $.clean_page_count.
metadata.why_justification: Derived figure `clean_page_count`: pages that clear every rule and can go to press untouched.

metadata.how_justification: Reads results.json with json.read_file and compares $.flagged_page_count.
metadata.why_justification: Derived figure `flagged_page_count`: pages carrying at least one finding.

metadata.how_justification: Reads results.json with json.read_file and compares $.finding_total.
metadata.why_justification: Derived figure `finding_total`: every finding raised across the batch — a different number from the count of pages carrying one, because several pages breach more than one rule.

metadata.how_justification: Reads results.json with json.read_file and compares $.dpi_low_count.
metadata.why_justification: Derived figure `dpi_low_count`: pages under the effective-resolution floor of their own press, which requires the placed scale to be applied and the per-press floor to be looked up.

metadata.how_justification: Reads results.json with json.read_file and compares $.margin_count.
metadata.why_justification: Derived figure `margin_count`: pages breaching the safe-margin rule once §3's full-bleed exception is applied.

metadata.how_justification: Reads results.json with json.read_file and compares $.bleed_short_count.
metadata.why_justification: Derived figure `bleed_short_count`: full-bleed pages short of the bleed §4 requires of them.

metadata.how_justification: Reads results.json with json.read_file and compares $.ink_over_count.
metadata.why_justification: Derived figure `ink_over_count`: pages over the ink cap of their own press.

metadata.how_justification: Reads results.json with json.read_file and compares $.spot_unsupported_count.
metadata.why_justification: Derived figure `spot_unsupported_count`: pages specifying more spot colours than their own press can run.

metadata.how_justification: Reads results.json with json.read_file and compares $.font_not_embedded_count.
metadata.why_justification: Derived figure `font_not_embedded_count`: pages arriving without embedded fonts.

metadata.how_justification: Reads results.json with json.read_file and compares $.element_short_count.
metadata.why_justification: Derived figure `element_short_count`: pages under their own element minimum.

metadata.how_justification: Reads results.json with json.read_file and compares $.element_shortfall_total.
metadata.why_justification: Derived figure `element_shortfall_total`: how many required elements the batch is still missing in total, which counts elements rather than the pages missing them.

metadata.how_justification: Reads results.json with json.read_file and compares $.imposition_invalid_sections.
metadata.why_justification: Derived figure `imposition_invalid_sections`: sections whose page count does not fit their binding under §9.

metadata.how_justification: Requires all 21 flagged page ids to appear in preflight_memo.md.
metadata.why_justification: The prompt asks the memo to account for every page carrying a finding.

metadata.how_justification: Requires all 9 section ids to appear in preflight_memo.md.
metadata.why_justification: The memo has to report the section-level imposition result, which means accounting for the sections.

metadata.how_justification: Requires both press ids to appear in the memo.
metadata.why_justification: The prompt asks the memo to call out pages whose verdict turns on their press, which cannot be done without naming the presses.

metadata.how_justification: Requires both per-press resolution floors (250, 300) to appear.
metadata.why_justification: The prompt asks for the limit each finding missed, and the resolution floor differs between the two presses.

metadata.how_justification: Requires the tighter ink cap (280%) and the 281% measured on PG-18 to appear.
metadata.why_justification: PG-18 is one point over the digital cap; naming the measured value against the limit is exactly what the prompt asks the memo to do.

metadata.how_justification: Requires the safe-margin floor, accepting decimal or fractional inches.
metadata.why_justification: The prompt asks the memo to name the limit each finding missed.

metadata.how_justification: Requires the memo to state the bleed minimum in the course of discussing bleed, accepting decimal or fractional inches.
metadata.why_justification: 0.125 in is the §4 minimum behind every BLEED_SHORT finding in the batch.

metadata.how_justification: Requires the memo's treatment of PG-21 to tie the full-bleed design to the safe-margin rule not applying, accepting a range of phrasings. Anchored on the page id because a correct memo also names the exception when ruling it out elsewhere.
metadata.why_justification: PG-21 carries no safe margin at all and is still clean, only because §3's full-bleed exception releases it. The prompt asks what clears a page whose numbers look like a breach.

assertion.expected: (?is)PG-21[\s\S]{0,600}?full[\s_-]?bleed[\s\S]{0,300}?(?:exempt|excepted|excluded|waive|not subject|does not apply|doesn't apply|do not apply|don't apply|not a finding|no finding|does not reach|releases|released|clears|cleared|intended)

metadata.how_justification: Requires the memo's treatment of PG-35 to discuss its bleed.
metadata.why_justification: PG-35 is a full-bleed page: §3 releases it from the safe-margin rule while §4 obliges it to carry bleed, and it is short. Reading the exception as a blanket pass is the mistake this page catches.

metadata.how_justification: Requires the memo's treatment of PG-03 to give its effective resolution, the scale it is placed at, or the word effective.
metadata.why_justification: PG-03 carries 450 dpi artwork and still fails, because placing it at 200% halves the resolution that reaches the plate. The measured value the prompt asks for is the effective one, not the artwork number.

metadata.how_justification: Requires the memo's treatment of PG-06 to reach its press or the digital floor of 250 dpi.
